basis: Focal epilepsy defined by motor seizures; muscle contractions do not establish primary muscle disease.
Congenital myopathy with weakness in 16/16; developmental delay only 2/16. Respiratory insufficiency from muscle weakness does not establish lung disease.
Epileptic brain disorder; metabolic, infectious and immune causes apply only to particular subtypes.
Inflammation of the vermiform appendix; neither infection nor an immune-mediated mechanism defines all appendicitis.
Inherited intestinal lactase deficiency causes impaired lactose digestion and severe neonatal diarrhea; an inborn carbohydrate metabolic disorder.
ID/white-matter disease; skeletal deformities 30-79%, hearing loss ~43-50%, cardiac defects 30-79%; ocular and growth hormone abnormalities omitted at cap.
Phosphatidylcholine biosynthesis disorder causing muscular dystrophy; intellectual disability 15/15 and dilated cardiomyopathy 6/13 (~46%).
Ichthyosporean parasitic infection; this organism-defined umbrella does not specify a consistent anatomical site.
Parathyroid secretory failure; nephrocalcinosis is commonly treatment-related or separately coded; basal ganglia calcification alone does not establish functional damage.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability and developmental delay in 5/5; optic nerve hypoplasia and joint contractures each only 1/5.
Embryonal carcinoma arising in the reproductive testis; no defining endocrine dysfunction or other covered organ involvement.
Poliovirus damages brainstem motor neurons; respiratory and swallowing impairment arise from neural dysfunction rather than intrinsic lung or gut damage.
Factor V-related coagulation protein disorder causing bleeding; no additional organ involvement established.
Alcohol-induced psychiatric umbrella; no common defining axial injury. Delirium and fetal alcohol neurodevelopmental damage are subtype-specific.
Meckel syndrome defines cystic renal dysplasia, CNS malformations and polydactyly; hepatic ductal plate malformation with fibrosis occurs in most.
Defining distal limb and urogenital malformations include urethral defects; reproductive anomalies have no axis. Isolated 1-patient CNS findings do not establish prevalence.
Ependymal neoplasm originating in the supratentorial brain.
Severe congenital neutropenia is a blood-cell disorder and an innate immunodeficiency; infections do not establish additional intrinsic organ damage.
TRIM8-related syndrome defined by glomerular disease and neurodevelopmental impairment; feeding difficulties do not establish intrinsic gastrointestinal injury.
Inherited melanin metabolism disorders predominantly comprise albinism with defining ocular dysfunction and cutaneous hypopigmentation; isolated ocular forms spare skin.
Usher syndrome combines sensorineural hearing loss and retinal rod-cone dystrophy, both 2/2; vestibular dysfunction belongs to the otologic axis.
Congenital anomalous pulmonary artery origin with cardiac shunting and failure; respiratory symptoms do not establish direct lung damage.
VIM-related nonsyndromic early-onset cataract affecting the lens.
Diabetes-related autonomic nerve damage; cardiovascular, gastrointestinal and bladder symptoms do not by themselves establish direct injury of those organs.
Benign alveolar epithelial neoplasm originating in the lung; tumor occupation establishes the primary organ despite usually absent symptoms.
